title: Weigh Ingredients and Make Flatbread on a Griddle
summary: The person follows a tablet recipe, sets up a kitchen scale, tares a bowl, and weighs out ingredients. A rolling pin and griddle pan suggest homemade flatbread such as tortillas or roti, rolled out and cooked on the stovetop.

nodes.name: Set up scale and recipe
nodes.instruction_novice: Wipe the kitchen scale, place it on a flat counter, and open your recipe where you can see it.
nodes.end_state: Clean scale sits on the counter beside the open tablet recipe.

checks.question: Is this step done: Set up scale and recipe?

nodes.name: Tare the mixing bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the empty bowl on the scale and press the tare button so it reads zero.
nodes.end_state: Bowl rests on the scale and the display reads 0.

checks.question: Is this step done: Tare the mixing bowl?

nodes.name: Weigh the flour
nodes.instruction_novice: Spoon flour into the bowl until the scale shows the amount in the recipe.
nodes.end_state: Bowl holds flour and the scale shows the target weight.

checks.question: Is this step done: Weigh the flour?

nodes.name: Add salt and other dry ingredients
nodes.instruction_novice: Tare again, then add the salt and any baking powder the recipe calls for.
nodes.end_state: Dry ingredients are in the bowl on top of the flour.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add salt and other dry ingredients?

nodes.name: Add fat
nodes.instruction_novice: Weigh the butter or oil and rub it into the flour with your fingertips until it looks like coarse crumbs.
nodes.end_state: Flour mixture looks crumbly with no large butter lumps.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add fat?

nodes.name: Add water and mix
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour in warm water a little at a time, stirring until a shaggy dough forms.
nodes.end_state: A rough ball of dough sits in the bowl with no dry flour left.

checks.question: Is this step done: Add water and mix?

nodes.name: Knead the dough
nodes.instruction_novice: Knead the dough on the counter for a few minutes until it is smooth and soft.
nodes.end_state: A smooth, elastic dough ball sits on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Knead the dough?

nodes.name: Rest the dough
nodes.instruction_novice: Cover the dough with a towel or lid and let it rest so it is easier to roll.
nodes.end_state: Covered dough ball sits in the bowl.

checks.question: Is this step done: Rest the dough?

nodes.name: Divide into portions
nodes.instruction_novice: Cut the dough into equal pieces, weighing them on the scale if you want them identical, and roll each into a ball.
nodes.end_state: Several equal dough balls are lined up on the counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Divide into portions?

nodes.name: Preheat the griddle
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the pan on the burner over medium-high heat and let it get hot.
nodes.end_state: Pan sits on the glowing burner, hot and dry.

checks.question: Is this step done: Preheat the griddle?

nodes.name: Roll out a round
nodes.instruction_novice: Dust a ball with flour and roll it out with the rolling pin into a thin, even circle.
nodes.end_state: A thin, flat circle of dough lies on the floured counter.

checks.question: Is this step done: Roll out a round?

nodes.name: Cook first side
nodes.instruction_novice: Lay the round in the hot pan and cook until bubbles form and the bottom has light brown spots.
nodes.end_state: Flatbread in the pan shows bubbles on top.

checks.question: Is this step done: Cook first side?

nodes.name: Flip and finish
nodes.instruction_novice: Flip it and cook the other side until spotted and puffed, then move it to a plate.
nodes.end_state: A cooked, browned flatbread rests on a plate.

checks.question: Is this step done: Flip and finish?

nodes.name: Repeat with remaining dough
nodes.instruction_novice: Roll and cook the rest of the balls the same way, stacking them under a towel to keep warm.
nodes.end_state: A covered stack of cooked flatbreads sits on the plate and no dough balls remain.

checks.question: Is this step done: Repeat with remaining dough?

nodes.name: Turn off stove and clean up
nodes.instruction_novice: Switch off the burner, clean the scale, and wipe down the counter.
nodes.end_state: Burner is off and the counter is clear and wiped.

checks.question: Is this step done: Turn off stove and clean up?
